premises.text: Developers waste large amounts of time in toil from software complexity, harming happiness and retention
premises.evidence_span: developers spend half their week in toil

premises.text: Observability and security tools leave developers lost in data and tools away from coding
premises.evidence_span: Developers are lost in a maze of tools they don't control, away from the coding they love to do

premises.text: AppMap delivers personal observability, performance, and security analysis inside the code editor as developers write
premises.evidence_span: AppMap delivers personal observability, performance, and security analysis to developers when they work to reduce toil

premises.text: AppMaps capture accurate runtime behavior across environments, data stores, and service boundaries—not static analysis
premises.evidence_span: AppMap is real code execution, not a static code analysis

premises.text: Automatic analysis alerts on issues such as performance and security flaws while developers work
premises.evidence_span: AppMap automatically analyzes this information to find issues why developers work, and it alerts them if it finds a problem

premises.text: Deep language/framework integrations and open source enable adoption across communities
premises.evidence_span: AppMap integrates deeply with popular languages and frameworks. And AppMap is open source to integrate with new languages and new communities

premises.text: Free for individuals, students, and open source via VS Code and JetBrains marketplaces
premises.evidence_span: AppMap is free for individuals, students, and open source projects from the VS Code and JetBrains marketplaces

value.text: Development teams reduce toil and ship more performant, secure, reliable code faster
value.evidence_span: AppMap helps development teams reduce toil and ship more performant, secure, and reliable code faster

secondary_value.text: Organizations gain faster onboarding and much lower mean time to repair
secondary_value.evidence_span: faster time to code onboarding and reduce mean time to repair flaws from weeks down to minutes

causal_links.evidence_span: see the behavior of their software as they write code
free for individuals, students, and open source projects

notes: Market-size/$85B and adoption counts excluded as framing/traction. Demo issue types folded into analysis capability (§4.1(5)). Postman partnership treated as illustration of editor runtime data, not separate premise.
